sources.entry: Suroi - 2D battle royale game inspired by surviv.io. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Suroi is an open-source, work-in-progress 2D battle royale game inspired by surviv.io, built with Bun.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Suroi as an open-source 2D battle royale game inspired by surviv.io and states it is still a work in progress. It provides setup steps to clone the repository and install dependencies with Bun. It supports a development mode that runs the server and client together (bun dev) or separately (bun dev:server and bun dev:client). For production, it describes building the client with bun build:client and starting the game server with bun start. The README says production builds are served using NGINX and points to the wiki for self-hosting details. A public instance is listed at suroi.io.
use_cases: self-host a battle royale game server
contribute to a TypeScript game project
how_to_run: git clone the repository (the README's clone URL is blank; use the repo's GitHub URL)
bun dev (or run bun dev:server and bun dev:client together)
bun build:client, then bun start for production
notable: Inspired by surviv.io 2D battle royale gameplay
Separate server and client dev commands for debugging
caveats: README states the game is a work in progress
Self-hosting requires NGINX setup, with details only in the external wiki
Development requires both server and client running simultaneously
